messages:
Marta (growth): Quick sync — planning a 3-week experiment: updated pricing calculator, new tier lexicon, and a short webinar to drive inbound. Need alignment on FAQ edits + lead routing. Timeline: draft by Wed, dev ship Fri, webinar Wed week 2.

Jasper (product): Love it. Can we add a benchmark narrative in the webinar — e.g., latency and cost-per-100k tokens examples comparing Hosted vs Dedicated? Marketing needs one clear slide.

Ty (growth): Re: tier names — usertesting flagged 'Starter' as vague. Proposal in the doc: Core / Growth / Dedicated. Also let's A/B two microcopy strings in the calc: "estimated monthly spend" vs "projected monthly spend".

Leanne (design): Prototype here: https://figma.com/file/abc123/pricing-calc-v3 — added CTA variations, tooltip copies, and a compact breakdown view. Added a subtle note about quantization with an inline explainer. :sparkles:

growth-bot: analytics: funnel check — 42% drop on the 'choose tier' step for EU traffic last 30d. Heatmap & session replay: https://heat.map/report/789

Sam (sales): Routing ask — when calculator outputs >= $10,000/mo projected, forward to enterprise queue + attach event props (company_size, industry, projected_monthly). Otherwise go to SDR nurture. OK?

Jasper (product): Yep. Tech implementation: add header `x-calculator-tier-signal` and route off that. Example rule for the routing service: ```
if (projected_monthly >= 10000) route('enterprise-sf') else route('sdr-nurture')
```

Marta (growth): Action items: @Leanne finalize CTAs by Tue; @Jasper create header+routing ticket for eng; @Ty stand up A/B with 10k users; @Sam confirm nurture templates. I'll draft FAQ updates (brief Q&As on burst pricing, quantization, committed discounts) and post in #marketing-drafts.

Leanne (design): Will do. One UI note — avoid 'quantization profile' phrase in the main calc; testers preferred 'model compression setting' or just 'performance mode'.

Ty (growth): Webinar format rec: 20 min product walkthrough + 10 min Q&A. Include a 'real cost breakdown' slide using a sample app (chatbot @50 req/s) so folks can map to their use case.

Sam (sales): I'll prepare two follow-up templates: 'enterprise follow-up' (sales-handoff) and 'growth-nurture' (pricing education).

Marta (growth): Thanks team. I'll schedule a planning call Thu 10:00am and drop an agenda. If you can't make it, pls add comments in-thread. :calendar:
